subject: Six clubs chase Feyenoord winger Anis Hadj Moussa as price passes 35 million pounds
title: Hadj Moussa: 35m and counting

lines.vo: Six clubs want one winger. Feyenoord reportedly rejected thirty-five million pounds.
lines.footage: Hadj Moussa goal compilation, Feyenoord match clip

lines.vo: Anis Hadj Moussa, twenty-four, Algerian: eight goals in fifteen games this season.
Last season: fourteen goals, seven assists. Feyenoord's price tag looks less like a bluff.
Newcastle may have missed a chance at thirty-three million pounds this summer. Awkward.
Add Sunderland, Brighton, Dortmund, Porto and Sporting. Six clubs, one winger, one very busy phone.
